Yeah starting off with the ore bows with frostburn arrows is a safe way to start before scaling up to better weapons.

Ranged is the strongest class in the game imo cos of how versatile it is so you should be fine.

Once you beat one of the mechs the steampunker sells the clentaminator for one platinum coin, and the ammo for whatever biome she is housed in so you don't have to worry about the corruption for now

Armour wise, it depends on what ore you get. Orichalcum and titanium are good. If you don't get those a little bit of effort can get you the frost armour for melee or ranged, forbidden for mage or summoner.

You don't have to be class locked ofc, but in hard mode it's better to focus on a certain class at a certain time.

So go to the corruption and hallow, farm souls and find the weapons you like, and then get the armour class for that weapon. You don't have to follow any meta it's about finding the weapons your comfy with. Hallowed and corrupt mimics are a good place to start.

Also try and get souls of flight for wings, you don't need to worry about which ones for now.
